home.heading: I’ll build the whole thing.
home.lead: From first idea to live product: design, code, payments and launch.

process.title: Clear steps, visible progress.
process.intro: Every stage ends with something you can open and check, not a status report.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.body: Goals, users, constraints and the smallest version worth launching.

design.title: Design
design.body: Key flows and screens first, then the architecture and the data model.

build.title: Build
build.body: Short iterations: frontend, backend, payments, integrations and tests together.

launch.title: Launch
launch.body: Production setup (domain, CI/CD, monitoring, alerts and backups), then the release.

support.title: Support
support.body: Fixes, improvements and new features, with an eye on metrics and alerts.

contact.title: Good things start with a conversation.
contact.description: Tell me what you want to build or fix: a few lines are enough. Open to projects, long-term contracts and ambitious teams.
contact.reply: I usually reply within a day.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page could not be shown. Try again; if it keeps failing, come back a little later.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is no page at this address. It may have moved or never existed.
